body:
We used to have test coverage published in CI to coveralls.io. However, we never use this data, so for now we are removing it in https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-go/pull/2220.

**Describe the solution you'd like** If in a future we want to start using this data, this is where we left off on. https://coveralls.io/github/temporalio/temporal-go-sdk?branch=master
title: Code coverage tooling
